name: Aelius Rufus
objective: Tell whoever saved him what he witnessed in Session 1
notes: Wounded survivor from Session 1. Non-combatant. Key witness.
gm_notes: Recovering in the medicus. Bandaged, mobile but slow. If party visits: no check — he recognises them and talks freely. Key intel: he heard Marius say 'Give it to me and I will keep you safe' while looking directly at whoever held the spear. He does not know why the spear spoke to that specific person — only that it did. Pass this detail to Cassia for her to react. He is not dangerous and will not fight under any circumstances. He is simply a scared soldier who saw something he cannot explain.
